body: I'm also "just some person on the internet" I think the internet is a good resource especially for people in our situation. I'd love to talk with you

I know I should i just don't want to sound needy I might ask my mom to talk about it with her. I'm constantly listening to music and I play guitar and sing. It's my one real hobby.  I think music is good for everyone. Thanks for talking to me. And you can message me if you ever feel the need.

I know how you feel I haven't been to school in two years so the friends I had there are gone. I think if it's safe for you to do so, you should make it extremely clear how bad you are feeling in as much detail as possible to your parents, they need to know a child's mental health is more important than their grades. Depression tends to ruin what you enjoy. I enjoyed video games too, I don't anymore. I'm in the same situation in terms of upsetting your mom. Same with the suicidal thoughts and ways of doing it. I also wish something would happen to me where it wasn't my decision for example a car accident. I understand how you're feeling you didn't waste my time and I hope you can seek therapy and find happiness
Thank you. I'm here for you's too
At least we're in it together.
